resources.string: Injects an OpenXR implicit API layer that streams PICO full-body tracking (XR_BD_body_tracking, XR_BD_motion_tracking) to the companion SteamVR OpenVR driver
IPv4 address of the PC running SteamVR and the Seamless PICO Motion Tracker driver. Leave blank to auto-discover on the local network
UDP port the SteamVR OpenVR driver listens on (default 39575)
Selects active SteamVR tracker roles in full-body mode: 3pt (waist, feet), 6pt (+ chest, knees), 8pt (+ elbows), 10pt (+ shoulders), or all (+ hips, wrists)
auto follows the headset motion tracker setting, body forces full-body joints, and object forces raw physical tracker poses
Removes local-network and same-subnet checks in steamlink vr so vr mode can connect over WireGuard VPN or routed non-local networks
Leave blank to use steamlink cached or advertised host addresses automatically
